economic_hypothesis: Quiet-inventory upward information repricing is a risk-seeking continuation mechanism and should be admitted only when broad market participation is positive. Oversold active-demand ignition is a forced-supply reversal mechanism and should be admitted only when broad participation is negative. Mixed regimes hold cash rather than combining incompatible mechanisms.
